title: Collabs & Features
theme: Duets, guest spots, and joint records — the collaborative side of 90s R&B
narrativePurpose: Reward players who know not just who made the music, but who made it together — features, joint labels, studio collabs, and supergroup history
toneProgression: Famous face time → credit knowledge → deep collab archaeology

vault.note: Digit 4 (index 3) is always visible. Vault code 1-9-9-7 — the year the feature credit became a genre convention. I'll Be Missing You, LSG's debut, Janet's Got 'Til It's Gone with Q-Tip. R&B and hip-hop stopped asking permission to share a record.

questions.question: LSG — the supergroup formed by Gerald Levert, Keith Sweat, and Johnny Gill — released their self-titled debut on which record label?

metadata.fact: LSG — the supergroup formed by Gerald Levert, Keith Sweat, and Johnny Gill — released their self-titled debut album on EastWest Records in 1997. EastWest was a division of the Atlantic/WEA family. The album reached #2 on the Billboard 200 and spawned the R&B hit 'My Body.'
metadata.storyHook: Three solo stars, one label, one album. LSG on EastWest in 1997 was the supergroup formula executed cleanly — and the charts confirmed it.

sources.title: LSG debut released by East West Records – Facebook

questions.question: Jermaine Dupri produced Usher's 1997 commercial breakthrough album. What was it called?

metadata.fact: Jermaine Dupri's production on 'My Way' yielded the hit 'You Make Me Wanna...' — Usher's first top 5 pop crossover.
metadata.sourceNotes: So So Def/LaFace/Arista 1997 liner notes for 'My Way' credit Jermaine Dupri as executive producer. Discogs Usher 'My Way' release lists Jermaine Dupri as primary producer. ASCAP publishing database confirms Dupri co-writes on 'You Make Me Wanna...' and lead singles.

questions.question: Mariah Carey's 1995 megahit 'Fantasy' built its groove around a sample from 'Genius of Love' — a track originally recorded by which band?

metadata.fact: 'Fantasy' (1995) samples Tom Tom Club's 1981 hit 'Genius of Love' — building its euphoric groove on one of the most infectious basslines of the New Wave era. Tom Tom Club was a side project of Talking Heads members Chris Frantz and Tina Weymouth.
metadata.storyHook: Mariah Carey. Ol' Dirty Bastard. One remix. The moment in 1995 when R&B and hip-hop stopped being different conversations.
metadata.sourceNotes: Verified: 'Fantasy' samples 'Genius of Love' by Tom Tom Club. Sources: WhoSampled https://www.whosampled.com/sample/107/Mariah-Carey-Fantasy-Tom-Tom-Club-Genius-of-Love/

sources.title: Fantasy sample of Genius of Love – WhoSampled

questions.question: Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis produced Janet Jackson's 1997 album exploring personal themes of sexuality and mental health. Name that album.

metadata.fact: The Velvet Rope debuted at #1 in 14 countries upon its 1997 release and is widely considered Janet's most personal album.
metadata.storyHook: The production duo that built Janet's career delivering her most vulnerable record.
metadata.sourceNotes: Virgin Records 1997 liner notes credit Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis as producers throughout The Velvet Rope. Discogs release for The Velvet Rope lists James Harris III and Terry Lewis. ASCAP database confirms writing and production credits for Harris and Lewis.

sources.title: The Velvet Rope – The Boombox interview with Jimmy Jam
